entities.summary: The Church of St. Ilija in Krupa na Vrbasu is a Serbian Orthodox church located in Krupa na Vrbasu, Bosnia and Herzegovina. It is located about twenty kilometers upstream from Banja Luka in the Republic of Srpska.
